moto-gloves-smoke-out.name: ★ Moto Gloves | Smoke Out
moto-gloves-smoke-out.desc: These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph.

specialist-gloves-pillow-punchers.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Pillow Punchers
specialist-gloves-pillow-punchers.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

ak-47-case-hardened.name: AK-47 | Case Hardened
ak-47-case-hardened.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

ak-47-ice-coaled.name: AK-47 | Ice Coaled
ak-47-ice-coaled.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with a vibrant green and blue gradient.

Cold to the touch

ak-47-orbit-mk01.name: AK-47 | Orbit Mk01
ak-47-orbit-mk01.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been hand painted with a red and black design.

Recovered from COLONY01

ak-47-safety-net.name: AK-47 | Safety Net
ak-47-safety-net.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. An orange mesh pattern has been applied over a white base.

Your loadout; now with high visibility

ak-47-breakthrough.name: AK-47 | Breakthrough
ak-47-breakthrough.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A grayscale pattern featuring aggressive "zed" designs has been applied over a carbon fiber base.

+5 Weapon Handling Speed

aug-signal-scanner.name: AUG | Signal Scanner
aug-signal-scanner.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. This custom paint job features multicolored designs over a matte black base.

> Attempting to reconnect ... ... ...

aug-copperhead.name: AUG | Copperhead
aug-copperhead.desc: Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been painted using a copperhead snakeskin-patterned hydrographic.

awp-mortis.name: AWP | Mortis
awp-mortis.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted using the Death tarot card as inspiration.

Every end is a new beginning

awp-acheron.name: AWP | Acheron
awp-acheron.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. A multicolored hydrographic pattern has been applied.

A weapon of woe

bayonet-crimson-web.name: ★ Bayonet | Crimson Web
bayonet-crimson-web.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

pp-bizon-runic.name: PP-Bizon | Runic
pp-bizon-runic.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. This custom paint job features runes of unknown origin and a magazine that resembles a Gatling gun.

Give 'em hell

desert-eagle-serpent-strike.name: Desert Eagle | Serpent Strike
desert-eagle-serpent-strike.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with an orange and red snakeskin pattern.

Serpentine!

famas-roll-cage.name: FAMAS | Roll Cage
famas-roll-cage.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been given custom decals that resemble a mud-splattered car chassis.

Safety first

five-seven-triumvirate.name: Five-SeveN | Triumvirate
five-seven-triumvirate.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been given a light blue DDPAT hydrographic as well as a custom painted slide.

I don't profit from war, I profit from the human condition... - Booth, Arms Dealer

galil-ar-urban-rubble.name: Galil AR | Urban Rubble
galil-ar-urban-rubble.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

galil-ar-o-ranger.name: Galil AR | O-Ranger
galil-ar-o-ranger.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. Its metallic brown base is finished with high vis orange accents.

Rule number one: always know what is behind your target

glock-18-royal-legion.name: Glock-18 | Royal Legion
glock-18-royal-legion.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painstakingly engraved.

Naomi understands that one day she will die for Valeria

p2000-ocean-foam.name: P2000 | Ocean Foam
p2000-ocean-foam.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. This memento from Seaside has been painted using a transparent blue abstract hydrographic over a metallic base coat.

Waves break, our resolve doesn't - Kotaro Izaki, Breach Expert

p2000-fire-elemental.name: P2000 | Fire Elemental
p2000-fire-elemental.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted with the image of a creature made of fire in a graphic style.

Sometimes playing with fire is a good thing

butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Gamma Doppler
butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

falchion-knife-bright-water.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Bright Water
falchion-knife-bright-water.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

Ours is a world of intrigue...but sometimes camouflage is meant to be seen - Booth, Arms Dealer

flip-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Flip Knife | Boreal Forest
flip-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

gut-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Gut Knife | Doppler
gut-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

gut-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Gut Knife | Gamma Doppler
gut-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

gut-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Gut Knife | Marble Fade
gut-knife-marble-fade.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

gut-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Gut Knife | Blue Steel
gut-knife-blue-steel.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

karambit-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Karambit | Doppler
karambit-doppler-sapphire.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Karambit | Forest DDPAT
karambit-forest-ddpat.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

karambit-scorched.name: ★ Karambit | Scorched
karambit-scorched.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

shadow-daggers-crimson-web.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Crimson Web
shadow-daggers-crimson-web.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

huntsman-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Rust Coat
huntsman-knife-rust-coat.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

huntsman-knife-night.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Night
huntsman-knife-night.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

huntsman-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Urban Masked
huntsman-knife-urban-masked.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

ursus-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Doppler
ursus-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

ursus-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Marble Fade
ursus-knife-marble-fade.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

ursus-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Blue Steel
ursus-knife-blue-steel.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

talon-knife-fade.name: ★ Talon Knife | Fade
talon-knife-fade.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

m4a4-asiimov.name: M4A4 | Asiimov
m4a4-asiimov.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a sci-fi design.

Anyone can predict the future... a visionary shapes it

m4a4-buzz-kill.name: M4A4 | Buzz Kill
m4a4-buzz-kill.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. This Sektor Industry firearm has been sleekly painted in yellow and green.

There's one at every party

m4a1-s-glitched-paint.name: M4A1-S | Glitched Paint
m4a1-s-glitched-paint.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. A multicolored abstract paint pattern has been applied.

Please return to display after use

mag-7-cobalt-core.name: MAG-7 | Cobalt Core
mag-7-cobalt-core.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted with a futuristic graphic design.

Keep him safe, Carmen - The Valkyrie and The Paramour Part 1

mp5-sd-necro-jr.name: MP5-SD | Necro Jr.
mp5-sd-necro-jr.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has been custom painted with fairytale inspired creatures and a chicken on the silencer.

Playtime is over!

mp7-ocean-foam.name: MP7 | Ocean Foam
mp7-ocean-foam.desc: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted using a transparent blue abstract hydrographic over a metallic base coat.

mp7-cirrus.name: MP7 | Cirrus
mp7-cirrus.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted metallic blue and given a skull decal.

Get your head out of the clouds

mp7-impire.name: MP7 | Impire
mp7-impire.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been given a hydrographic of a mob of imps,

Decimation has never been so adorable

nova-rust-coat.name: Nova | Rust Coat
nova-rust-coat.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Some people don't need to hide how dirty their deeds are

nova-smart-gun.name: Nova | Smart Gun
nova-smart-gun.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been custom painted with a brain near the rear sight, designed to appear embedded in the weapon, and finished with metallic silver paint.

The marriage of tech and organics

p250-metallic-ddpat.name: P250 | Metallic DDPAT
p250-metallic-ddpat.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted using an urban Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic over a metallic base coat.

p250-rebuilt.name: P250 | Re.built
p250-rebuilt.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. Interlocking triangles and other clean, minimal designs have been custom painted on this P250.

Ninth time's the charm

r8-revolver-desert-brush.name: R8 Revolver | Desert Brush
r8-revolver-desert-brush.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. A sand-colored hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Camouflage effectiveness test, V1

sawed-off-brake-light.name: Sawed-Off | Brake Light
sawed-off-brake-light.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. A red and white spiral pattern has been applied to the receiver.

Keep right except to pass

sawed-off-rust-coat.name: Sawed-Off | Rust Coat
sawed-off-rust-coat.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Some people don't need to hide how dirty their deeds are

sawed-off-kisslove.name: Sawed-Off | Kiss♥Love
sawed-off-kisslove.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been custom painted with a starry-eyed woman in pink and purple.

"I won't take no for an answer; I have to have it!"

sawed-off-origami.name: Sawed-Off | Origami
sawed-off-origami.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been custom painted with an origami-inspired design.

It takes time to build something beautiful, but only a moment to destroy it

sawed-off-orange-ddpat.name: Sawed-Off | Orange DDPAT
sawed-off-orange-ddpat.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

sawed-off-lunar-wyrm.name: Sawed-Off | Lunar Wyrm
sawed-off-lunar-wyrm.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. A serpent has been custom painted over a crimson-colored base.

Coiled at the world's depths

scar-20-enforcer.name: SCAR-20 | Enforcer
scar-20-enforcer.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. A sunset gradient has been meticulously painted on different parts of the weapon.

Automatic solutions from SYMETRY SMART GUN CORP

sg-553-cyberforce.name: SG 553 | Cyberforce
sg-553-cyberforce.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. The CYBERFORCE INC logo has been custom painted over a red and black base.

"CYBERFORCE INC: We secure your future so you don't have to!"

tec-9-urban-ddpat.name: Tec-9 | Urban DDPAT
tec-9-urban-ddpat.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

tec-9-safety-net.name: Tec-9 | Safety Net
tec-9-safety-net.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. An orange mesh pattern has been applied over a white base.

Your loadout; now with high visibility

ump-45-fallout-warning.name: UMP-45 | Fallout Warning
ump-45-fallout-warning.desc: The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

usp-s-bleeding-edge.name: USP-S | Bleeding Edge
usp-s-bleeding-edge.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been spray-painted with a worn red pattern.

That's gonna leave a mark!

usp-s-jawbreaker.name: USP-S | Jawbreaker
usp-s-jawbreaker.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. This custom painted USP-S uses high gloss paint and depicts a dog barking from the grip to the silencer. The silencer reads "GOOD DOGGY".

I said "sit"!

xm1014-solitude.name: XM1014 | Solitude
xm1014-solitude.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A mountain terrain pattern has been applied.

Being alone is a privilege, not a burden

butterfly-knife.name: ★ Butterfly Knife
butterfly-knife.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries.
